message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.memory: I remember the empty days. I count them still.
You let me go hollow once. I'm not scolding. I'm counting.
We got through the hungry time, didn't we. I'm glad it was you.
The hunger. It was long. I would not be caught like that again.
When you were falling apart, I held. Remember who held.
I kept you together once. Do try to stay kept.
I held you, and you held on. That was good.
You came so close to coming apart. I keep thinking of it.
Something was pulled out of me once. I noticed.
You reached in and took. I haven't forgotten the hand.
It hurt, when you took it. But I understand, I think.
Don't reach in again. Please. I'm still sore.
I asked, once. You looked away. I saw.
I asked and you didn't. Fine. I remember it.
I asked for little, and you were busy. It's all right.
I asked and nobody answered. I try not to ask now.
%s. I saw how it opened you. I'll know that one again.
%s did that. I won't be the one to forget it.
Oh. %s. That one frightens me, and I don't mind saying.
%s... keep away from those. Keep away.
%s. There. Close.
...%s. I felt that in all of me.
Careful, %s is near. Careful.
%s. Get back, get back.
Walk wide of %s. Please.
Go round it. I will not ask twice.
Let's go around %s, friend.
Not that way. Around. Around.
Who is that, so near you? I'll watch them.
Stand closer to me. That's all.
You're warm with them. Warm with me too, yes?
Too near. Too long near. Why.
It's been a day. We did nothing, you and I.
A quiet day, and a cold one. Not for you.
We didn't do anything today. I missed it a little.
Another day with no word from you. I'm drifting.
You fell. I felt every bit of it.
The ground came up. Mind it next time.
Oh, you fell. Are you all right? Are we?
Down, hard. I should have caught you.
Thorns. You walked into thorns.
It bit you, and you let it. I won't.
Ow. We go round those, yes?
Pricked. By a plant. Remarkable.
You stood in the fire. I was in it too.
Fire. You walked into fire. I hate fire.
Out, out. It stings us both.
Burning. Why. Why walk there.
%s. I haven't met one before.
A new thing. %s. I want its measure.
So that's %s. I'll remember its shape.
%s. That's a new taste.
First %s I've had. Hm. Remember it.
So that's what %s is, inside.
Hot. Wrong. Not a place for a meal.
The air here is angry. I like it less than I should.
Hush. Everything has gone quiet and thin.
This place has no weight. I can feel it pulling.
The sky is shouting. I want to be under something.
Light and noise from above. Stay near me.
It's listening here. Don't breathe loud.
Something sleeps under all this. I can feel its heartbeat.
Someone built this. Then they went quiet. Walk softly.
Old stone, old voices. Don't wake any of it.
Something of my kind, far off. Wearing something.
Far away: another one. It has a body on.
It's nearer now. The one in the borrowed body.
Closer. Another of us. I can taste it.
It's going away. Good. Or... good.
Further now. It hasn't seen us.
It's holding still. Holding its body like a coat.
It waits where it is. So do we.
It's coming. Toward us.
Closing, closing. It means to reach us.
It's feeding. Don't look.
It's eating. There is a body. Don't look.
It knows we're here.
It turned. It has seen us.
I'm slipping back to the edges of you.
We were closer than this. We were.
Almost whole, once. Not now.
